description: Add documentation (comprehensive README with setup instructions, screenshots placeholders, architecture overview) and ensure all files have consistent formatting, proper exports, and the project is ready to run after npm install.
steps: Update README.md with: project title and description, features list, tech stack, architecture overview diagram (text-based), setup instructions (prerequisites, clone, npm install, create .env with API key, npx expo start), project structure tree, screenshots section (placeholder), API setup guide (how to get OpenWeatherMap API key), environment variables documentation, contributing guidelines.

Create src/utils/helpers.ts with utility functions: formatTemperature(temp, unit), formatDate(timestamp), formatTime(timestamp), getTimeOfDay() returns 'morning'|'afternoon'|'evening'|'night', capitalizeFirstLetter(str).
Review and fix any cross-file import issues - ensure all imports reference existing files with correct relative paths.

Add index.ts barrel exports in each src/ subdirectory (src/components/index.ts, src/screens/index.ts, src/hooks/index.ts, src/services/index.ts, src/constants/index.ts, src/types/index.ts) for clean import paths.
Ensure .gitignore covers: node_modules/, .expo/, dist/, .env, *.log, ios/, android/ (generated native dirs), .DS_Store, coverage/.
acceptance_criteria: README.md is comprehensive with clear setup instructions and architecture overview
Utility functions exist in src/utils/helpers.ts with proper TypeScript types
Barrel index.ts files exist in all src/ subdirectories
All cross-file imports are consistent and reference correct paths
.gitignore covers all standard React Native/Expo generated files
verification: Read README.md and confirm it has all required sections
Verify .env.example exists with the API key placeholder
Check that barrel exports reference all files in their directories
Spot-check 3-4 files to confirm import paths match actual file locations
